description: TransitieVisieWarmte is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by warmteatlas.nl. Transition Visions Heat (TVWs) are municipal policy documents to achieve a natural gas-free heat supply. All municipalities had to have the TVWs available by the end of 2021. The TVWs contain a vision and possible solution directions for the intended heat transition in a municipality. Coverage: NL. Its keywords include transitievisiewarmte database. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
